questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code maps failures to HTTP status codes and error responses? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The store returns an error created as fmt.Errorf("db: %w", ErrCampaignPaused). What does the caller of POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/impressions receive?
choices: 400 with code bad_request, since the error was wrapped twice
500, because the error is not exactly ErrCampaignPaused
404, because the campaign cannot be used

questions.prompt: A client posts a 3 MiB JSON array of impressions. What status does it get?
choices: 202, since only the first 1 MiB is read and processed

questions.prompt: A batch of 100 impressions is valid except that the 60th has an empty ad_id. What happens?
choices: The first 59 are recorded and the response is 202 with accepted 59
The whole batch is rejected with 422 and nothing is sent to the store
The batch is sent to the store, which decides how to handle the bad event
